f.food_id, f.external_food_code, f.name, f.brand, f.category, f.nutrition_basis_amount, f.nutrition_basis_unit, f.serving_amount, f.serving_unit, f.gram_per_piece, f.calories, f.protein_g, f.carbs_g, f.fat_g, f.sugar_g, f.sodium_mg, f.fiber_g, f.iron_mg, f.phosphorus_mg, f.potassium_mg, f.vitamin_a_ug_rae, f.beta_carotene_ug, f.retinol_ug, f.source, f.created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM foods f JOIN ( SELECT food_id FROM ( SELECT food_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY name ORDER BY CASE WHEN brand IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN serving_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN nutrition_basis_unit = 'g' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, food_id ASC ) AS rn FROM foods WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\' ) ranked_foods WHERE rn = 1 ) representative_foods ON representative_foods.food_id = f.food_id ORDER BY f.name ASC, f.food_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) FROM foods WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\'

SELECT f.food_id, f.name, COUNT(di.food_id) AS record_count, MAX(d.eaten_at) AS last_recorded_at FROM diet_items di JOIN diets d ON d.diet_id = di.diet_id JOIN foods f ON f.food_id = di.food_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY f.food_id, f.name ORDER BY record_count DESC, last_recorded_at DESC, f.food_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
